stories.title: CMMC's Phase 2 suspension locked in with binding regulation
stories.why: A new class deviation moves the pause on third-party assessments for this security standard from policy to an enforceable rule.

stories.title: What is defending our warfighters actually worth?
stories.why: Stacy Bostjanick, a former DoD executive and Tara Lemieux, an Army veteran, electronic warfare signals intelligence officer, explain why CMMC needs to continue.

stories.title: Nuclear agency’s top IT official: ‘Industry has not done enough’ on security
stories.why: NNSA CIO James Wolff said he’s planning to add AI into vendor-vetting processes and that technology providers should aim to produce tools that are more secure.

stories.title: GSA and CMS continue Medicaid tech vendor collaboration, but its impact is likely limited, experts say
stories.why: The partnership is part of the broader CMS effort to help states comply with Medicaid work requirements enacted by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

stories.title: NASA starts to craft engineering, tech services recompete
stories.why: The space agency is aptly calling this new contract ORBIT and using industry feedback to structure the competition.

stories.title: Pentagon pores over heaps of industry feedback on CMMC reform
stories.why: Input from contractors is expected to inform the department's reforms to the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification program.

stories.title: Pentagon partners with venture studio to pilot shared savings contract model via $100M OTA
stories.why: This unique agreement is designed to demonstrate a new framework where vendors are paid only for the costs they eliminate for DOD.
